467:t_2:47.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「You... when did you get in here...?」

467:t_2:48.en:
$$暗黒寺$$
「During the $$時獄戦役$$ I slipped up and walked right into your trap...」

467:t_2:49.en:
$$暗黒寺$$
「Thanks to that, I couldn't tell the proprietress of $$くろがね屋$$ about $$あしゅら$$'s scheme, and it ended in the worst possible way.」

467:t_2:50.en:
$$暗黒寺$$
「Still... you people abducting Dr. $$剣造$$ too was a stroke of luck for us, I'll admit.」

467:t_2:51.en:
$$つばさ$$
「Thanks for the help, $n. You drawing these guys' attention is what let me slip out, too.」

467:t_2:53.en:
$$クロス$$
「Typical of $$甲児$$'s buddy. Storming into their hideout all by yourself... you've got some damn nerve.」

467:t_2:54.en:
$$お菊$$
「Birds of a feather, as the saying goes, hmm?」

467:t_2:55.en:
$$ジャンゴ$$
「But leave the rest to us. You couldn't shoot a woman anyway.」

467:t_2:60.en:
$$ホワイト$$
「$n! You'll come with me?」

467:t_2:64.en:
$$安$$
「Hey, $n! What's the meaning of letting the enemy's woman get away!?」

467:t_2:65.en:
$$暗黒寺$$
「Listen, Student. ...Were you led astray by that woman's charms, pal?」

467:t_2:69.en:
$$つばさ$$
「$n has $n's own reasons. Let him stand by his principles this time.」

467:t_2:70.en:
$$お菊$$
「If that's what you say, Proprietress...」

467:t_2:71.en:
$$つばさ$$
「Besides, that woman... She's got a pretty face, but she's one tough customer.」

467:t_2:72.en:
$$つばさ$$
「Torture her, do whatever you like, and she still wouldn't talk.」

467:t_2:74.en:
$$つばさ$$
「You've no time to mope, $n. You've already climbed aboard, so there's no getting off... There's something we need you to do.」

467:t_2:78.en:
$$つばさ$$
「As you can see. This man was once parasitized by $$ケドラ$$, and it took over his will.」

467:t_2:79.en:
$$つばさ$$
「To break free of that, he threw away most of his body. All he has left in decent shape these days is about his brain.」

467:t_2:82.en:
$$剣造$$
「To save my son, $$甲児$$... Please hear my last request.」

467:t_3:5.en:
$$甲児$$
(Where there is hope, light is born...)

467:t_3:8.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Now is the time to banish the darkness of $$ハーデス$$'s Underworld with the light within you!」

467:t_3:9.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「The Demon God of Light... $$マジンガーＺ$$ will surely answer your feelings!」

467:t_3:11.en:
$$甲児$$
(The power to tear through the darkness...! Now's the time...!)

467:t_4:5.en:
$$ルゥ$$
「We rushed him straight to the ICU, but he remains in critical condition.」

467:t_4:6.en:
$$シモン$$
「To think $$竜馬$$ took that much damage...」

467:t_4:7.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「$$勇者ガラダブラ#pilot$$... Formidable, as one would expect.」

467:t_4:10.en:
$$甲児$$
「It's because I'm so useless that $$竜馬$$...」

467:t_4:13.en:
$$隼人$$
「$$竜馬$$ would never throw his life away. This time it was simply his own mistake.」

467:t_4:14.en:
$$弁慶$$
「But that guy survives no matter the situation... After all, he's the man who came back from $$陰月$$.」

467:t_4:15.en:
$$隼人$$
「So don't let it weigh on you. Come tomorrow, he'll wake up looking like nothing happened.」

467:t_4:17.en:
$$葵$$
「We meant to defend Japan from the Empire, and now one enemy after another keeps showing up.」

467:t_4:18.en:
$$タケル$$
「Director $$大塚$$ said so too, but that's probably exactly why Japan has never fallen under the Empire's rule, even to the end.」

467:t_4:20.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「Geographically, being sandwiched between $$新日本$$, which kept resisting to the very end, and the East Asian front was a big factor, but...」

467:t_4:21.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「There are also too many inexplicable phenomena, and those are obstacles to the Empire's conquest of Japan.」

467:t_4:22.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Japan really is kind of special, isn't it...」

467:t_4:23.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Various super robots get developed, $$ゲッター線$$ pour down, Photon Power energy lies dormant, and on top of that it even becomes a target for the Angels' attacks...」

467:t_4:24.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「That's where it differs greatly from $$新日本$$.」

467:t_4:27.en:
$$隼人$$
「Japan's existence should probably be called a kind of singularity...」

467:t_4:28.en:
$$弁慶$$
「Is it related to the $$時空震動$$?」

467:t_4:29.en:
$$隼人$$
「...The possibility of every kind of incident is concentrated in this small country...」

467:t_4:30.en:
$$隼人$$
「To put it simply, $$マジンガー$$, $$ゲッター$$, $$ゴッドマーズ$$, $$トライダー$$, $$ダイ・ガード$$, $$ダンクーガノヴァ$$...」

467:t_4:31.en:
$$隼人$$
「By rights, they may have existed in a different world altogether.」

467:t_4:32.en:
$$タケル$$
「What's more, during the $$時獄戦役$$, $$アクエリオン$$ and the EVA came here too...」

467:t_4:33.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「So the real Japan is $$新日本$$, and this Japan exists as a foreign body, a collection of possibilities...?」

467:t_4:34.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「That it was chosen as the site of $$ミケーネ$$'s revival must be connected to that, too.」

467:t_4:35.en:
$$隼人$$
「And then we, branded with the $$烙印$$, returned there...」

467:t_4:36.en:
$$シモン$$
「The $$烙印$$... The mark of those fated to be tossed about by the $$時空震動$$, huh...」

kept_omissions: 467:t_4:10: 竜馬さんが… trails off with the verb unspoken; rendered 'It's because I'm so useless that Ryouma...' (leaves the outcome implicit).
467:t_4:4: 竜馬さんは… trails off (asking about his condition); kept open-ended.
467:t_4:29: あらゆる事件の可能性 - subject kept impersonal, as the scene is Hayato's general theory.
467:t_2:77: この人が…甲児の… trails off; 'This man is... Kouji's...' (father) left implicit.
uncertain: 467:t_2:65: セイガクさん (Ankokuji to $n) is not in the sheet or corpus; guessed a nickname for a student and rendered 'Student'. If it is a school name it should be 'Seigaku'.
467:t_2:69: two $n in one sentence kept as in the Japanese ('$n has $n's own reasons'), plus 'him/his' since $n is male.
467:t_2:49: 女将 = 'the proprietress' (settled) used as an address ('Proprietress!') in 52/68/70.
467:t_2:60: 私と一緒に来てくれるの？ rendered as a hopeful 'You'll come with me?'.
467:t_2:48/50: あんた等 (Chrono side) = 'you people'; 時獄戦役 written with the token, no 《》 in the Japanese.
467:t_2:71: タマは普通じゃない = 'one tough customer'.
467:t_4:7: 勇者ガラダブラ used the #pilot token ('Hero Garadoublas'); 'Formidable, as one would expect' for さすがと言うべきか.
467:t_4:35: 烙印（スティグマ） rendered with the $$烙印$$ token only (the ruby gloss dropped).
467:t_4:32: ＥＶＡ = 'the EVA' (settled short form), 使徒 = 'Angels' (plain).
467:t_3:6: Zeus's 兜甲児 = $$兜甲児$$ (full-name token, 'Kouji Kabuto').
